MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Record keeping in aquaculture.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Record keeping in aquaculture.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Record keeping in aquaculture.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Record keeping in aquaculture.

   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

21. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
